source_conditions.pressure_warning: Anomalous pneumatic-plug behavior was observed near 100 Pa after pumpdown; source used a two-hour pumpdown protocol.
source_conditions.flow_boundary: hopper supply to rotary pocket feeder, not free gravity discharge
source_conditions.gamma_threshold_claim: For ICN-LHT-1 and this apparatus, sustained flow was observed at Gamma >= 3.4; Gamma_cr is only bounded above by 3.4 because no vibration levels between 0 and 3.4 were tested.
source_conditions.sensing: collection load cells 5 Hz, 0-5 kg, ±0.05% FS; accelerometers 500 Hz; video 1920x1080 at 30 fps
source_conditions.quality_caveat: Supplementary agglutinate tests observed vibration-induced upward size segregation and fragmentation during repeated handling.

source_design_reconstruction.interpretation: These 480 entries are empty structural placeholders for an 8-assembly × 60-parabola source study. They contain no measured outcomes, no per-parabola assignments inferred from raw data, and no sensor values. Obtain permission and source files from the corresponding author, then import with provenance and digests before any source-reproduction claim.

proposed_gamma_threshold_screen.design_policy: This screen tests below Gamma 3.4, which the source did not cover. Derive displacement amplitude from measured frequency and local gravity; reject cells outside actuator stroke, thermal or structural limits. Gamma 3.4 is not universal. Use randomized blocks and reconditioning.

proposed_segregation_shear_cell.primary_measurement: time- and position-resolved concentration field C_i(x,z,t) by tomography or registered sectioning
proposed_segregation_shear_cell.design_policy: The 4:1 size ratio, 50/50 mass fraction and pressure levels are analyst-selected screening values. Measure vacuum adhesion and particle properties before mapping target Bo_m to real material conditions; independently control normal load and shear rate so Bo_m and I are not confounded.

vibration_assisted_feeder_source_reconst.claim_ceiling: No source raw data were imported and no tests in this file have been run. The source article states that sensor data/video are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request. The 480 slots are empty templates only. Gamma threshold statements are specific to the cited ICN-LHT-1 test configuration. The segregation matrix is proposed only; lunar dense-flow segregation has not been measured.
vibration_assisted_feeder_source_reconst.data_availability: The article states that load-cell records, accelerometer measurements and video are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request. No public raw 480-row dataset was located. Source record slots in this file are empty templates, not reconstructed observations.

lhs1_ground_hopper_regime_extension.source_replication_status: The source abstract/available article record establishes four regimes and qualitative factor effects but exact numeric source factor levels must be recovered from the full experimental tables before a matched replication. This screen is an analyst-selected extension, not the source experiment.
lhs1_ground_hopper_regime_extension.design_policy: Keep frequency and acceleration amplitude independent: equal Gamma at different frequencies changes displacement and can produce different regimes. Include rated hopper charge mass because amplitude effectiveness weakens with sample mass growth. Confirm each regime with spatial/temporal imaging rather than classifying from total flow rate alone.

factors_interpreted.material: LHS-1 and ICN-LHT-1 remain separate material families and separately characterized batches
factors_interpreted.gravity: 1-g terrestrial baseline vs 0.16-g lunar parabolic condition
factors_interpreted.gamma: 0 vibration plus 1.5, 3.4 and 6 as proposed analyst levels; Gamma=3.4 is a cited successful tested ICN-LHT-1 setting, not a threshold
factors_interpreted.frequency: low/middle/high are equipment-calibrated bands, not imported numeric source levels
factors_interpreted.charge_mass: 0.25 and 1.0 of rated test-rig charge; normalize using actual measured mass and bed height

cross_gravity_material_transfer_screen.policy: Use identical hopper, outlet, vibration mount, feeder, camera, load cell and accelerometer architecture in both gravity campaigns. Match Gamma rather than motor command; record frequency, peak acceleration, peak displacement, bed height, packing state and wall contact. Use one independently characterized batch per material and keep batch identity explicit. Parabolic runs and ground runs must be blocked/randomized and reconditioned. Compare effects with a mixed-effects model that includes material × gravity × Gamma × frequency × charge-mass interactions.
cross_gravity_material_transfer_screen.claim_ceiling: No physical campaign has been run. The matrix is a proposed bridge to separate material and gravity effects under a common architecture. Actual frequency bands and charge-mass limits must be set by hardware commissioning. Do not pool the two simulants or claim lunar equivalence from a matched Gamma alone.
